name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page

name: task_add
description: Add a task to a project board (todo list / kanban card). Optional column, due date, estimate, priority, tags and notes.

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: What the task is, e.g. 'Write the launch email'

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project or board name. A partial name matching exactly one existing project is used as that project. Defaults to your only board.

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Column to start in; defaults to the first column (backlog)

arguments.name: estimate_minutes
arguments.desc: How long you think it will take, in minutes

name: task_list
description: List tasks as a table, filtered by project, column, tag, due date or overdue.

arguments.name: due_before
arguments.desc: Only tasks due on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD, 'today', 'Friday', '+7d')

arguments.name: overdue
arguments.desc: Only tasks past their due date

name: task_move
description: Move a task to another column on its board.

name: task_update
description: Change any field of a task: title, notes, due date, estimate, priority, tags or project.

arguments.name: due
arguments.desc: New due date, or 'none' to clear it

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Move the task to another existing project board

name: task_done
description: Mark a task done: it moves to the done column and is stamped with the time.

name: task_search
description: Find tasks whose title, notes, tags or id match a query.

name: board
description: Column-by-column summary of a project board: task counts and estimate totals.

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Which board; defaults to your busiest one

name: task_start_timer
description: Return the exact arguments to pass to the time-tracker server's timer_start for this task, and record the link on the task.

name: task_log_time
description: Add real minutes worked to a task, so estimate and actual can be compared.

arguments.name: minutes
arguments.desc: Minutes to add; a negative number corrects an over-count

name: project_list
description: All project boards with open task counts, remaining estimate and overdue counts.

name: overdue
description: Every task past its due date, across all boards.

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: Measure against this day instead of today (YYYY-MM-DD, 'next Monday', '+7d')

name: weekly_review
description: Done versus planned for a week, with estimate against actual minutes per project.

arguments.name: week
arguments.desc: ISO week, e.g. '2026-W36'. Defaults to this week. Past weeks are a Pro feature.

name: columns_set
description: Replace the columns of one board (Pro). Tasks sitting in a removed column move to the first column.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: The new column names in order, at most 12, e.g. ['inbox','next','doing','done']
